<thought>We have a subnetwork between nodes A and X1 with a measured resistance of 6.667 Ω. The notes say there are two resistors, one twice the other. The simplest topology that fits is two resistors in series: R and 2R. Their sum equals the measured resistance, so R = 6.667 / 3 ≈ 2.222 Ω and 2R ≈ 4.444 Ω. This can be represented with an intermediate node (e.g., N1) connecting A‑R1‑N1‑R2‑X1.</thought>
<final_answer>{"resistors": {"R1": 2.222, "R2": 4.444}, "connections": [["A", "N1", "R1"], ["N1", "X1", "R2"]]}</final_answer>
